                  the Latin Pastoral-Congregational Christianity world

                  (CSEL 44), vendored separately. A twin scan,

                  same original 1911 printing.
    Content note: Verified this pass: title page confirms Pars IV, Ep.
                  CLXXXV-CCLXX, 1911. Ep. 185 (De Correctione
                  Donatistarum Liber -- the same "Correction of the
                  Donatists" already vendored in English translation
                  for the Donatism world, row 5 of that world's own
                  Registry) confirmed present with its own opening
                  line ("Laudo et gratulor et admiror, fili
                  dilectissime Bonifati..."). This range includes Ep.
                  195 and 202, cited elsewhere in this project's own
                  corpus map. No specific letter's content beyond Ep.
                  185's opening has been read for a claim this pass.
